claims.text: In 2026, Upper middle income countries account for 32.20% of countries eligible for HIV funding.
For 2026-2028, global allocations were US$10.51 billion.
Total allocations decreased by 19.60% from 2023-2025 to 2026-2028.
Of the Window 7 funding requests submitted on 17 February 2025, 12 of 14 used Tailored for Focused Portfolios.
